chunks: We were told by Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid, may Allah be pleased with him, that he said: We were told by Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Isma'il ibn Marrar, from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman, from Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) who said:

I asked him and said: May I be sacrificed for you, what was the coffin of Musa? And how much was its capacity? He said: Three cubits by two cubits. I said: What was in it? He said: The staff of Musa and the Sakinah. I said: And what is the Sakinah? He said: The Spirit of Allah that speaks. If they were to dispute in something, it would speak to them and inform them by clarifying what they seek.
ai.seo_question: What is the Sakinah and what was inside the Ark of Moses?
ai.summary: In this narration from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Ma'ani al-Akhbar*, Imam al-Rida (AS) clarifies the nature of the Ark of Moses, identifying the 'Sakinah' not merely as a physical object but as the Spirit of Allah (Ruh Allah) that speaks to resolve communal disputes. This definition highlights the Ark's role as a divine instrument for guidance and clarity, distinguishing it from the general concept of tranquility mentioned in the Quran. The description underscores the continuity of divine communication through tangible signs in Shia theological understanding.

en.basel-kadem: 2.	We were told by Muhammed bin Hasan bin Ahmad bin Waleed, may Allah be pleased with him, that he said: We were told by Muhammed bin Hasan al-Saffar, from Ibrahim bin Hashim, from Isma’eel bin Marrar, from Yunus bin Abdul-Rahman, from Abu’l-Hasan, peace be upon him, that he said:

I asked him and said: May I be sacrificed for you, what was the coffin of Musa? And how much was its width? He said: Three upper arms by two upper arms. I said: What was in it? He said: The staff of Musa and the tranquility. I said: And what is the tranquility? He said: The Spirit of Allah that speaks. If they were to dispute in something, it would speak to them and inform them by clarifying what they seek (to solve).
